dct_description_sm: This data is to provide open data availability for interested readers, for the publication in the International Journal of Molecular Sciences (see Related Publication). The study investigated the protective effects of protegrin-1 (PG-1) on pathogen-induced colitis. This dataset includes both animal trial results and gene expression results included in the publication to support our results.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: Protective and anti-inflammatory effects of Protegrin-1 on Citrobacter rodentium intestinal infection in mice
